before.name: 比阳光更明亮的
before.effectDescription: 增加暴击率，施放战技时获得增益效果
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases CRIT Rate. Gains buff stacks when using Skill

after.name: 比阳光更明亮的
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的暴击率提高18%。当装备者施放普攻时，获得1层【龙吟】，持续2回合。每层【龙吟】使装备者的攻击力提高18%，能量恢复效率提高6%。【龙吟】最多叠加2层。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 18%. When the wearer uses their Basic ATK, they will gain 1 stack of Dragon's Call, lasting for 2 turns. Each stack of Dragon's Call increases the wearer's ATK by 18% and Energy Regeneration Rate by 6%. Dragon's Call can be stacked up to 2 times.

before.name: 她已闭上双眼
before.effectDescription: 增加最大生命值，施放终结技时恢复全队生命
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases Max HP. Restores HP for all allies when using Ultimate

after.name: 她已闭上双眼
after.effectDescription:
使装备者的生命上限提高24%，能量恢复效率提高12%。当装备者的生命值降低时，使我方全体造成的伤害提高9%，持续2回合。
每个波次开始时，为我方全体回复等同于各自已损失生命值80%的生命值。
after.effectDescriptionEn:
Increases the wearer's Max HP by 24% and Energy Regeneration Rate by 12%. When the wearer's HP is reduced, all allies' DMG dealt increases by 9%, lasting for 2 turn(s).
At the start of every wave, restores HP to all allies by an amount equal to 80% of their respective lost HP.

before.name: 沿着已逝之岸
before.effectDescription: 增加暴击伤害，终结技伤害提高
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases CRIT DMG. Increases Ultimate DMG

after.name: 行于流逝的岸
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的暴击伤害提高36%。当装备者击中敌方目标时，使敌方陷入【泡影】状态，持续1回合。装备者每次攻击时，对每个目标只可触发1次。装备者对陷入【泡影】状态的目标造成的伤害提高24%，终结技造成的伤害额外提高24%。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 36%. When the wearer hits an enemy target, inflicts Mirage Fizzle on the enemy, lasting for 1 turn. Each time the wearer attacks, this effect can only trigger 1 time on each target. The wearer deals 24% increased DMG to targets afflicted with Mirage Fizzle, and the DMG dealt by Ultimate additionally increases by 24%.

before.name: 余生的第一天
before.effectDescription: 增加防御力，被攻击时对敌人施加灼烧
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases DEF. Applies Burn to enemies when attacked

after.name: 宇宙市场趋势
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的防御力提高16%。当装备者受到攻击后，有100%的基础概率使敌方目标陷入灼烧状态，每回合造成等同于装备者40%防御力的持续伤害，持续2回合。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's DEF by 16%. When the wearer is attacked, there is a 100% base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to 40% of the wearer's DEF for 2 turn(s).

before.name: 余生的第一天
before.effectDescription: 增加击破特攻，施放战技时攻击力提高
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases Break Effect. Increases ATK when using Skill

after.name: 铭记于心的约定
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的击破特攻提高28%。当装备者施放终结技时，暴击率提高15%，持续2回合。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 28%. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases CRIT Rate by 15%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

before.name: 余生的第一天
before.nameEn: Day One of My New Life
before.effectDescription: 增加防御力和效果抵抗

after.name: 余生的第一天
after.nameEn: Day One of My New Life
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的防御力提高16%。进入战斗后，使我方全体的全属性抗性提高8%。同类技能无法重复生效。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's DEF by 16%. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by 8%. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

before.name: 嘉果
before.effectDescription: 对精英和首领敌人伤害提高
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases DMG against Elite and Boss enemies

after.name: 乐圮
after.effectDescription: 使装备者对当前生命值百分比大于50%的敌方目标造成的伤害提高20%。
after.effectDescriptionEn: The wearer deals 20% more DMG to enemy targets whose HP percentage is greater than 50%.

before.name: 嘉果
before.effectDescription: 进入战斗时增加全队攻击力
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases team ATK at battle start

after.name: 嘉果
after.effectDescription: 战斗开始时，立即为我方全体恢复6点能量。
after.effectDescriptionEn: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 6 Energy for all allies.

before.name: 欢迎来到宇宙之都
before.effectDescription: 使装备者的速度提高18%，造成的欢愉伤害无视目标20%防御力
before.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%. Elation DMG dealt ignores 20% of target's DEF

after.name: 欢迎来到银河城
after.effectDescription: 使装备者的速度提高18%，造成的欢愉伤害无视目标20%的防御力。当装备者对自身单体施放终结技时，获得20点【笑点】。该效果最多触发1次，施放3次普攻后重置可触发次数。
after.effectDescriptionEn: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%. The Elation DMG dealt ignores 20% of the target's DEF. When the wearer uses Ultimate on themselves, gains 20 point(s) of "Punchline." This effect can be triggered up to 1 time. And resets this trigger count after using Basic ATK 3 time(s).
